page_title: HOF 1-2 FRE | Hoffenheim v Freiburg 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+1' Christian Streich decides to make a substitution. Vincenzo Grifo will be replaced by Noah Weisshaupt (Freiburg).
90+1' It's time for a substitution. Kiliann Sildillia (Freiburg) comes on in place of Christian Gunter.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
85' Here's the change. Angelo Stiller leaves the pitch and Tom Bischof (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
84' Substitution. Manuel Gulde (Freiburg) replaces Michael Gregoritsch.
84' Here is a change. Roland Sallai is going off and Christian Streich gives the last tactical orders to Ritsu Doan (Freiburg).
84' That will be all from Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Maximilian Beier.
82' Lukas Kubler (Freiburg) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
78' Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
76' Ihlas Bebou (Hoffenheim) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for an infringement.
74' Christian Streich has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yannik Keitel (Freiburg) replacing Merlin Rohl.
71' Substitution. Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) did his best and is replaced by Julian Justvan.
70' The referee blows for a cooling break.
67' The Freiburg players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
64' The game is interrupted now, Angelo Stiller (Hoffenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
62' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
61' OFF THE POST! Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the right post!
60' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
59' Referee Sven Jablonski sees the trip by Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
58' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the right post! What a huge opportunity!
55' Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the six-yard box wasn't accurate enough and the ball went inches over the bar.
54' The ball goes out of play. Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.
53' Pavel Kaderabek (Hoffenheim) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
50' 1 - 2 Goal! Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
50' Hoffenheim get a corner.

49' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
46' Pellegrino Matarazzo has made a change at the break. Kevin Vogt (Hoffenheim) has come on in place of Attila Szalai.
46' The second half has just started.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+6' Sven Jablonski sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+4' The Freiburg players celebrate the goal but the referee immediately signals a VAR review. Let's see what happens. Big moment in the game.
45+3' 0 - 2 After a goalmouth scramble the ball rebounds out to Roland Sallai (Freiburg) who buries it from close range into the roof of the net.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.
45' Some neat passing and movement from Freiburg as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
39' 0 - 1 It's a goal! Attila Szalai (Hoffenheim) scores. Unfortunately for him, it's an own goal!
36' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
35' Great teamplay by Hoffenheim as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
32' Merlin Rohl (Freiburg) makes a slide tackle, but referee Sven Jablonski blows for a foul.
30' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Freiburg.
28' Roland Sallai (Freiburg) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
25' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
24' A fine corner kick lands on the head of Attila Szalai (Hoffenheim), but he is unable to direct it accurately and it flies well wide of the right post from close in.
24' Corner kick. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity.
21' Christian Gunter (Freiburg) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
19' The game is interrupted as Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) is flagged offside.
16' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
15' Sven Jablonski shows a yellow card to Philipp Lienhart (Freiburg) for his blatant foul.

14' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Noah Atubolu to get hold of the ball.
10' A pass by Roland Sallai (Freiburg) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

7' Nice touch by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) as he latched on to an accurate cross and attempted to direct the ball with a fine header towards the net, but the goalkeeper reacted quickly to keep it out.
7' Freiburg work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

6' A snap shot by Michael Gregoritsch (Freiburg) from the edge of the area flies towards the right side of the goal, but Oliver Baumann produces a good save to thwart him. The referee points to the corner flag and Freiburg will take a corner.
5' A goal, which was scored by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim), was disallowed due to offside.
3' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the left post.
1' The match has just started.
Hoffenheim will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Sven Jablonski.
